name: pixelate-svg-filter
title: Pixelate Svg Filter
author: SikandarJODD
description: An SVG filter definition component for applying configurable pixelation effects.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
	type PixelateSvgFilterProps = {
		id: string;
		size?: number;
		crossLayers?: boolean;
	};
	let {
		id = "pixelate-filter",
		size = 16,
		crossLayers = false,
	}: PixelateSvgFilterProps = $props();
</script>

<svg class="absolute inset-0">
	<defs>
		<filter {id} x="0" y="0" width="1" height="1">
			{"First layer: Normal pixelation effect"}
			<feConvolveMatrix
				kernelMatrix="1 1 1
                          1 1 1
                          1 1 1"
				result="AVG"
			/>
			<feFlood x="1" y="1" width="1" height="1" />
			<feComposite
				operator="arithmetic"
				k1="0"
				k2="1"
				k3="0"
				k4="0"
				width={size}
				height={size}
			/>
			<feTile result="TILE" />
			<feComposite in="AVG" in2="TILE" operator="in" k1="0" k2="1" k3="0" k4="0" />
			<feMorphology operator="dilate" radius={size / 2} result={"NORMAL"} />
			{#if crossLayers}
				{"Second layer: Fallback with full-width tiling"}
				<feConvolveMatrix
					kernelMatrix="1 1 1
                              1 1 1
                              1 1 1"
					result="AVG"
				/>
				<feFlood x="1" y="1" width="1" height="1" />
				<feComposite
					in2="SourceGraphic"
					operator="arithmetic"
					k1="0"
					k2="1"
					k3="0"
					k4="0"
					width={size / 2}
					height={size}
				/>
				<feTile result="TILE" />
				<feComposite in="AVG" in2="TILE" operator="in" k1="0" k2="1" k3="0" k4="0" />
				<feMorphology operator="dilate" radius={size / 2} result={"FALLBACKX"} />
				{"Third layer: Fallback with full-height tiling"}
				<feConvolveMatrix
					kernelMatrix="1 1 1
                              1 1 1
                              1 1 1"
					result="AVG"
				/>
				<feFlood x="1" y="1" width="1" height="1" />
				<feComposite
					in2="SourceGraphic"
					operator="arithmetic"
					k1="0"
					k2="1"
					k3="0"
					k4="0"
					width={size}
					height={size / 2}
				/>
				<feTile result="TILE" />
				<feComposite in="AVG" in2="TILE" operator="in" k1="0" k2="1" k3="0" k4="0" />
				<feMorphology operator="dilate" radius={size / 2} result={"FALLBACKY"} />
				<feMerge>
					<feMergeNode in="FALLBACKX" />
					<feMergeNode in="FALLBACKY" />
					<feMergeNode in="NORMAL" />
				</feMerge>
			{/if}
			{#if !crossLayers}
				<feMergeNode in="NORMAL" />
			{/if}
		</filter>
	</defs>
</svg>
